originalStudy.title: Glycemic indices, glycemic load and glycemic response for seventeen varieties of dates grown in Saudi Arabia
originalStudy.authors: AlGeffari MA, Almogbel ES, Alhomaidan HT, El-Mergawi R, Barrimah IA
originalStudy.table: Table 2; mean GI 55.2 (SEM 7.7), range 42.8–74.6 across 17 Tamer-stage varieties; glucose reference
originalStudy.qualityEvidence: Published human GI study in 19 healthy adults. Each Tamer-stage date variety was tested once in 9–10 participants using a 50 g available-carbohydrate portion and glucose reference. The reported across-variety mean was 55.2 (SEM 7.7), with a wide 42.8–74.6 range; variety differences were not statistically significant, but this is not ISO 26642-confirmed and does not establish values for other ripeness stages or cooked date mixtures.

records.limitations: Low-confidence food-family mean for unsweetened Tamer-stage dried dates as sold. This ingredient estimate is not a measurement of the recipe or meal.
